4. **Relevance of DAR in clinical practice**: The final point underscores the significance of DAR in determining clinical relevance. While acute phase anal sensory score measurements may not contribute significantly to prognosis, other criteria such as acute phase voluntary anal contraction and sacral sparing criteria can predict better outcomes for patients undergoing spinal cord surgery.
